description: Header file defining classes and functions for managing undo actions in the map editor of the Wesnoth game, including undo/redo stacks, action details, and related operations.

classes.name: map_undo_action
classes.description: Represents a single undoable action in the map editor, including terrain changes, selection changes, map data changes, and starting location changes.

methods.name: map_undo_action
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new undo action.

methods.name: undo_terrains
methods.description: Returns the map of terrain locations and their previous terrains for undo.

methods.name: redo_terrains
methods.description: Returns the map of terrain locations and their new terrains for redo.

methods.name: undo_selection
methods.description: Returns the set of locations selected before the action for undo.

methods.name: redo_selection
methods.description: Returns the set of locations selected after the action for redo.

methods.name: new_map_data
methods.description: Returns the new map data string after the change.

methods.name: old_map_data
methods.description: Returns the old map data string before the change.

methods.name: undo_starting_locations
methods.description: Returns the map of starting locations and their previous sides for undo.

methods.name: redo_starting_locations
methods.description: Returns the map of starting locations and their new sides for redo.

methods.name: add_terrain
methods.description: Records a terrain change from old to new at a specific location.

methods.name: terrain_set
methods.description: Checks if terrain changes have been recorded in this action.

methods.name: set_selection
methods.description: Records a change in selection sets for undo/redo.

methods.name: selection_set
methods.description: Checks if selection changes have been recorded.

methods.name: set_map_data
methods.description: Records a change in map data.

methods.name: map_data_set
methods.description: Checks if map data has been changed in this action.

methods.name: add_starting_location
methods.description: Records a change in starting location side and position.

methods.name: starting_location_set
methods.description: Checks if starting location changes have been recorded.

methods.name: add_undo_action
methods.description: Adds an undo action to the undo stack, managing stack size and redo stack.

methods.name: exist_undo_actions
methods.description: Returns true if there are undo actions available.

methods.name: exist_redo_actions
methods.description: Returns true if there are redo actions available.

methods.name: pop_undo_action
methods.description: Removes and returns the most recent undo action, storing it in the redo stack.

methods.name: pop_redo_action
methods.description: Removes and returns the most recent redo action, storing it in the undo stack.

methods.name: clear_undo_actions
methods.description: Clears all undo and redo history.
